citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:30 pm on August
17, 2026. The inspector called the licensee upon arriving at their facility. The licensee said they were away and it would
be more than an hour before they could return and there was no other person available who could accompany an
inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
